remaining_doubts: 3758 is printed as '3758*' (asterisk = footnote 'Thread Locking Patch'); kept part_number as '3758' with the footnote in notes.
3500 weight is printed as .035 lb, lower than the smaller 10-series 3501 (.073 lb); copied verbatim, may be a catalog typo.
3653 is printed with Material 'Steel' and Finish 'Stainless' (other stainless rows say Stainless-Steel); copied verbatim.
F-A858 row carries both F and M badges; recorded series as ['F'] only per the no-metric rule.
